correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md Jacobian determinant independently verifies p_b(lambda)=lambda^3+lambda^2+a lambda+2a sqrt(b). Routh–Hurwitz places stable region 0<b<1/4; at b=1/4 roots are -1 and ±i sqrt(a), and transversality dRe(lambda)/db=a/(a+1)>0. The full quadratic B(u,v)=(0,2u_3 v_3,0) and normalized eigenvectors yield G21=-2w(12w-5i)/[3(w-i)(2w-i)], so exact symbolic simplification l1=-w(8w²+1)/[(w²+1)(4w²+1)]<0 for w=sqrt(a)>0. Independent SymPy matrix inversion confirmed expression, sign and derivative (not simply trusted VERIFY_OK). Nondegenerate Hopf theorem supplies unique local orbitally stable branch for b>1/4; stable third eigendirection persists.
